propositions: Current clarity measure rewards volume and section presence without enforcing content requirements aligned to plan-writing guidance or graph altitude
Clarity computation is duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py, creating drift risk and maintenance burden
Deterministic AC verification coverage (proved_items/total_items) and placeholder detection in Scope/Approach can be reliably added without semantic judgment
Required-section shape should be keyed on graph altitude (leaf vs. container) rather than ticket type, with Context/Problem and Approach mandatory for leaves and child decomposition for containers
Acceptance criteria text hygiene checks (bundled outcomes, subjective terms, unproved hedges) and structured file_impact validation are mechanically testable additions that do not require LLM review
